data.summary:
Engineering Leader with 15+ years in CloudOps, DevOps, and, SRE, leading teams of up to
40+ engineers and delivering 99.99% uptime for global SaaS platforms.
Proven record in multi-cloud architecture, automation, and large-scale distributed systems,
delivering 30% cost savings and accelerating release cycles from weeks to hours. • Proven 8-year track record in engineering leadership, delivering large-scale cloud and
automation initiatives with measurable business impact.
Extensive expertise in DevOps practices and SRE principles, delivering high-availability,
resilient, and scalable systems.
Proficient in multi-cloud environments including AWS, GCP, Azure, and Oracle Cloud, with
hands-on experience in architecture, migration, and optimization.
Skilled in DevOps toolchains such as Git/GitHub, Jenkins, Docker, and Kubernetes for CI/CD
automation and container orchestration.
Experienced in enterprise monitoring and observability solutions including Datadog,
AppDynamics, Prometheus, and Zabbix for proactive incident prevention.
Recognized trainer and mentor in Oracle WebLogic, Cloud, and DevOps, enabling team
upskilling and knowledge transfer across global teams.
Strong leadership in strategic planning and governance, driving enterprise cloud strategy, IT
compliance, stakeholder alignment, and global delivery excellence.
PROFESSIONAL ACHIEVEMENTS
Delivered 99.9% uptime for critical production systems by implementing High Availability &
Failover strategies.
Architected self-healing infrastructure for 100+ Linux servers, reducing MTTR by 50% via
automated anomaly detection (Python + Datadog).
Spearheaded cloud migration projects and saved a lot annually in infrastructure costs. • Implemented CI/CD pipelines, reducing deployment time significantly.
CORE LEADERSHIP HIGHLIGHTS
Strategic Roadmap Execution: Led multi-cloud platform engineering across 4 clouds (AWS,
Azure, GCP, OCI), achieving 99.99% uptime for mission-critical retail SaaS products.
DevOps Transformation: Architected self-service CI/CD pipelines and IaC frameworks
(Terraform, Ansible, Helm) cutting infra provisioning time from 3 days to 45 minutes.
Global Team Leadership: Managed 35+ engineers across geographies, fostering a culture of
engineering excellence, agile delivery, and innovation.
• Cost Optimization: Achieved 30% annual cloud spend reduction through reserved capacity,
autoscaling policies, and resource rightsizing.
